An expert-play presentation with the game's own music and effects.
The original intro and credits
Original Amiga graphics, with independent game logic and audio replay in Go.
A familiar Amiga presentation

The expert player takes control
Movement, shots, collisions and rewards follow the normal game rules.
Tracking the next enemy formation

Collecting cash for the merchant

Working through the first stage
Positioning matters as much as firepower in the narrow passages.
Keeping clear of the scenery

The first section leads to the merchant
The ship keeps its remaining shield and earned cash.
The original merchant: equipment, sales and repairs
Purchases use cash earned during the game.
Back in the level after the merchant
The same ship continues through the second section.
Different formations need different firing positions

The original terrain and enemy-wave layouts
